raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Add `peft>=0.20.0` to `requirements/test/xpu.in`. This enables HF reference models to load LoRA adapters. Hf-vs-vllm comparison tests on speech-to-text models failed on XPU because of missing peft to load audio adapter. ## Claims - `peft` is not installed in vllm dependencies for XPU. Hfrunner with speech-to-text models requires `peft` to load audio adapters, otherwise the model will perform incorrectly and have wrong outputs. So hf-vs-vllm tests on speech-to-text models fail on XPU. - For cuda and rocm, `peft` has been installed so those cases can pass. - Installing peft will fix these ut failures where peft is required by Hfrunner to correctly run a speech model. ## Validation ### Before this PR To reproduce: ``` pytest -s -v tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_granite_speech.py::test_models[10-128-2048-bfloat16-ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b-ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b] pytest -s -v tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_transformers_audio.py::test_transformers_audio_generation[ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b] ``` result: - the ut failed. - Warnings point out that peft is not installed and the model will perform incorrectly. The warnings are like: ``` WARNING transformers.models.granite_speech.modeling_granite_speech:modeling_granite_speech.py:506 Config indicates that a lora adapter should be present, but peft is not installed; this will cause the model to perform incorrectly when audio inputs are provided. Please install peft and reload the model! ``` ### After this PR to reproduce: ``` pip install --no-deps peft\>=0.20.0 pytest -s -v tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_granite_speech.py::test_models[10-128-2048-bfloat16-ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b-ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b] pytest -s -v tests/models/multimodal/generation/test_transformers_audio.py::test_transformers_audio_generation[ibm-granite/granite-speech-3.3-2b] ``` result: the two cases passed. ## Details cuda peft: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/4b1c04e76fe9ac3ca8b7e541dd423e7d5f38dc60/requirements/test/cuda.in#L23 rocm peft: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/4b1c04e76fe9ac3ca8b7e541dd423e7d5f38dc60/requirements/test/rocm.in#L22-L23
